text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez! Happy birthday! Happy, super-duper 
happy birthday to youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, Teio. Out of all the 
well-wishes I've received, your pure, 
innocent words resonate with me the most.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pre-zi-dent. I was just thinking... 
What if you were never born...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wondered, 'What would have happened to 
me?' It's everything I've always aimed 
for, so if you weren't there, I felt like 
the current me might disappear too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, even if that were so, there is no 
need to worry. I hear the bonds of destiny 
between Umamusume are strong, flowing 
endlessly like a great river.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because of the headwaters, I am here, and 
you are here. The unbroken torrent of the 
imperial lineage will never cease. —As 
long as there are dreams.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: As long as there's a dream... Then...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, others will soon follow. Heirs to 
your radiance and mine, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Teio, if you're going to give me 
something, I want a promise. Will you 
continue to carry on this eternal river 
alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! Of course, Pre-z-dent!! Let's 
connect our Triple Crown dreams together!
